agent-body.description: Control plane — prefer this for multi-step work: supervisor, aggregated MCP gateway (muscle/spine/heart/eyes/immune/mouth), autonomic CLI
agent-body.when: Any task that needs execute, workflows, budget, sandbox, UI QA, approvals, or cluster health — use body gateway tools instead of improvising

agent-brain.description: Turn routing, memory, skills, and upstream federation to agent-body

agent-spine.when: Multi-step repeatable tasks (release notes, stacked PRs, bugfix loops)

agent-muscle.description: Sandboxed command execution and training jobs
agent-muscle.when: Run shell/tests/builds without ad-hoc host scripting

agent-mouth.description: AST command validation and human approval gates
agent-mouth.when: Risky commands or HITL approval before continue

agent-immune.when: Untrusted code or dependency CVE checks

agent-eyes.description: DOM describe, screenshot diff, local VLM
agent-eyes.when: UI verification without dumping raw HTML into context

agent-nerves.when: Cluster event bus / multi-organ async messaging

agent-tui.description: Terminal dashboard for organ health and live workflows
agent-tui.when: Operator visibility into the running cluster
